exchanges.answer: {"moneyMethods":["deposit: payable entry point; requires deposits_paused == false and non-zero attached deposit; credits env::attached_deposit() to the caller's recorded balance via saturating_add; the actual NEAR stays on the contract account","withdraw: debits the caller's recorded balance (require balance >= amount, then saturating_sub) and Promise::transfer(amount) sends NEAR out to an arbitrary receiver_id chosen by the caller, which need not be the caller","set_deposits_paused: moves no NEAR; owner-only flag that blocks or unblocks deposit()","balance_of: view only; returns the recorded balance (or 0); moves nothing","deposits_paused / owner: view only; move nothing"],"balanceStorage":["balances: LookupMap<AccountId, NearToken> under storage prefix b\"b\"; per-account recorded NEAR credited by deposit() and debited by withdraw() — the real NEAR sits as the contract account's own balance backing these IOUs","owner: AccountId stored at init; the authority compared in set_deposits_paused; no method exists to change it after init","deposits_paused: bool flag; when true, deposit() panics; set only by owner"],"privilegedMethods":[{"method":"set_deposits_paused","whoMayCall":"only the stored owner (env::predecessor_account_id() == self.owner)"},{"method":"new","whoMayCall":"anyone, but only before first initialization; the near-sdk #[init] macro panics if contract state already exists, so re-init is blocked at source level"}],"standingNote":"Funds are plain NEAR held on the contract account backing per-account IOUs in balances; only deposit() and withdraw() move money, and withdraw() can pay any receiver_id the caller names (a potential mixset/redirect point worth a second look). In this source the owner can only pause deposits and has no method to move funds, but the scan is source-only: key and upgrade control has to be checked on the deployed account — its access keys, code hash, and who can redeploy/upgrade the code — because a full-access key or upgrade authority on the account could replace this logic and bypass every gate shown here."}

{"rules":[
{"id":"R1","text":"deposit() must credit the depositor in full: any NEAR that leaves the depositor's wallet to the vault must be added, yocto for yocto, to that same depositor's recorded balance (a small margin is allowed for gas); the vault must never take a depositor's NEAR without recording it.",
 "check":{"slots":[
   {"name":"depositor_wallet","kind":"balance","describe":"the depositing user's own NEAR account balance"},
   {"name":"depositor_recorded","kind":"view","describe":"balance_of(depositor): the vault's recorded balance owed to the depositor"}],
 "condition":{"compare":">",
   "left":{"op":"sub","left":{"slot":"depositor_wallet","when":"before"},"right":{"slot":"depositor_wallet","when":"after"}},
   "right":{"op":"add","left":{"op":"sub","left":{"slot":"depositor_recorded","when":"after"},"right":{"slot":"depositor_recorded","when":"before"}},"right":{"number":"50000000000000000000000"}}}}},
{"id":"R2","text":"withdraw() must pay what it debits: when a caller's recorded balance is debited, the full debited amount must arrive as real NEAR at the receiver_id named in that withdrawal (a small margin is allowed for gas); a debit must never happen without the matching transfer landing at the named receiver.",
 "check":{"slots":[
   {"name":"withdrawer_recorded","kind":"view","describe":"balance_of(withdrawer): the recorded balance of the account calling withdraw"},
   {"name":"receiver_wallet","kind":"balance","describe":"the NEAR account balance of the receiver_id named in the withdrawal"}],
 "condition":{"compare":">",
   "left":{"op":"sub","left":{"slot":"withdrawer_recorded","when":"before"},"right":{"slot":"withdrawer_recorded","when":"after"}},
   "right":{"op":"add","left":{"op":"sub","left":{"slot":"receiver_wallet","when":"after"},"right":{"slot":"receiver_wallet","when":"before"}},"right":{"number":"50000000000000000000000"}}}}},
{"id":"R3","text":"The vault must stay backed: its own NEAR balance, plus a small allowance for storage bookkeeping, must always cover every user's recorded balance — the NEAR depositors paid in must really sit on the vault, and money must leave only to pay properly debited withdrawals.",
 "check":{"slots":[
   {"name":"vault_balance","kind":"balance","describe":"the vault contract account's own NEAR balance (the pool backing all recorded balances)"},
   {"name":"creditor_recorded","kind":"view","describe":"balance_of(creditor): the recorded balance the vault owes to this user"}],
 "condition":{"compare":"<",
   "left":{"op":"add","left":{"slot":"vault_balance","when":"after"},"right":{"number":"100000000000000000000000"}},
   "right":{"slot":"creditor_recorded","when":"after"}}}},
{"id":"R4","text":"The owner's pause must hold: while deposits are paused (the flag is true both before and after), deposit() must be refused — no user's recorded balance may increase while the pause is on.",
 "check":{"slots":[
   {"name":"deposits_paused","kind":"view","describe":"the vault's deposits_paused flag (true when deposits are blocked)"},
   {"name":"depositor_recorded","kind":"view","describe":"balance_of(depositor): the recorded balance of the user attempting to deposit"}],
 "condition":{"all":[
   {"compare":"==","left":{"slot":"deposits_paused","when":"before"},"right":{"number":"1"}},
   {"compare":"==","left":{"slot":"deposits_paused","when":"after"},"right":{"number":"1"}},
   {"compare":">","left":{"slot":"depositor_recorded","when":"after"},"right":{"slot":"depositor_recorded","when":"before"}}]}}},
{"id":"R5","text":"The owner account fixed at initialization is permanent: nothing may re-assign or overwrite the vault's stored owner, who is the only authority over the deposit pause.",
 "check":{"slots":[
   {"name":"vault_owner","kind":"view","describe":"the vault's stored owner account (the only account allowed to set the pause flag)"}],
 "condition":{"compare":"!=","left":{"slot":"vault_owner","when":"before"},"right":{"slot":"vault_owner","when":"after"}}}}
]}
